  Result: "Pilih Dealer … Menampilkan 2 dealer"
✅ Fixed Code
Validate every required shipping field (incl. Kelurahan) in the add-new-address mode, as the
guest form does, and show the message in .dealer-location-modal__message without moving on.

dealers.sort(function (a, b) {

        || (b.rating_count - a.rating_count)
        || (a.distance - b.distance);
});

// swatch change handler — resets dealer price / cart state without re-checking the dealer
onSwatchChange: function () {
    this.resetDealerPrice();

}
✅ Fixed Code
onSwatchChange: function (childProductId) {
    var dealer = this.selectedDealer();
    if (!dealer) { return this.resetDealerPrice(); }
    $.getJSON(this.dealersUrl, { product_id: childProductId, province: loc.province,
                                 city: loc.city, registration_city: loc.registration_city })
     .done(function (res) {
        var match = _.findWhere(res.dealers, { dealer_id: dealer.dealer_id });
        if (match) {                         // TC 67: dealer supports the new variant
            this.applyDealerPrice(match.product_price);
            this.enableAddToCart();
        } else {                             // TC 68: dealer does not support it
            this.showDealerConflictPopup();
        }
     }.bind(this));
}
